description: This file contains hook implementations related to the Drupal Language module, defining and altering language types, negotiation methods, and fallback candidates.

methods.name: hook_language_types_info
methods.description: Defines language types with their properties, including a custom type and a fixed negotiation method.

methods.name: hook_language_types_info_alter
methods.description: Alters the description of a custom language type.

methods.name: hook_language_negotiation_info_alter
methods.description: Modifies the configuration path for a custom language negotiation method.

methods.name: hook_language_fallback_candidates_alter
methods.description: Reverses the order of fallback language candidates.

methods.name: hook_language_fallback_candidates_OPERATION_alter
methods.description: Reverses fallback candidates for 'node' entity type operations.
